+    def on_broken_pipe(self) -> None:
+        """This function is called when a `BrokenPipeError` is raised while writing output.
+        This can occur when piping Rich output on Linux and macOS, e.g. into `head`.
+        The default implementation silences further output and exits with status 1.
+        Override this method in a subclass to change this behaviour.
+        See https://docs.python.org/3/library/signal.html#note-on-sigpipe for details.
+        """
+        self.quiet = True
+        try:
+            devnull = os.open(os.devnull, os.O_WRONLY)
+            os.dup2(devnull, self.file.fileno())
+        except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
+            pass
+        raise SystemExit(1)
